title: Here’s Where to Shop Affordable Austin City Limits Music Festival 2026 Tickets Online
summary: The annual music festival in Texas features Charli xcx, Turnstile, Rüfüs Du Sol, Lorde, Twenty One Pilots, The xx and others.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Austin City Limits Music Festival is back in action for 2026. The two-weekend event starts on Friday (Oct. 2) for week one and on Friday (Oct. 9) for week two. It takes place at Zilker Park in Austin, Texas.

Its 2026 lineup includes Labrinth, The Chainsmokers, Leon Thomas , Amyl and the Sniffers, The Bleachers, Lykke Li, Suki Waterhouse, Geese, Blood Orange, Audrey Hobert and many others. Meanwhile, Charli xcx, Turnstile, Rüfüs Du Sol, Lorde, Twenty One Pilots and more are scheduled to headline during the music festival. Check out a lineup of bands and recording artists here .

Shop ACL music Fest Tickets at Ticketmaster

Tickets to the music festival first went on sale through Live Nation and Ticketmaster , while the retailer’s Face Value Exchange program is an option for fans to resell tickets.

However, many of the dates have either sold out, or are very close to selling out, so one of the best ways to find Austin City Limits tickets online is through third-party sites, such as StubHub , SeatGeek , Vivid Seats , TicketNetwork , Gametime , Event Tickets Center and others. All online retailers guarantee authentic tickets in time for the festival. Prices may be above or below face value at times.
